items.title: Integer Holdings (ITGR) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After KKR Deal Reshapes Analyst Views
items.summary: The updated analyst model for Integer Holdings now points to a fair value of US$112.14, up from US$97.56, which reflects a roughly 15% uplift in the price target. Much of this shift ties back to fresh Street commentary following KKR’s agreed all cash offer of US$127 per share, with analysts reframing views around the stock through the lens of deal terms and closing risk.
